{{Top}}
{{Quote|The case is inconclusive, but the processor doesn't appear to be at fault. The subject claims he committed crimes simply 'for love of money.'|[[Industrial Automaton/Legends|Industrial Automaton]] investigators, after interviewing [[4-LOM/Legends|4-LOM]]|<ref name="NEGTD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>}}
A '''processor''' was a type of component used in technology<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> such as [[Droid/Legends|droids]] so that they could function without the aid of a signals from a centralized computer. Types of processors included [[Basic processor|basic]] and [[Heuristic processor/Legends|heuristic processors]]. When a droid was built properly, it was usually the processors that were the starting point, followed by the physical structure.<ref name="NEGTD" /> Processors were also used in medical technology, such as [[Athakam Medtech/Legends|Athakam]]/[[Rhinnal State Medical Academy|RSMA's]] [[Bioscan Unit]], and miniaturized processors were present in [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Sensor array/Legends|sensor arrays]] to gather data from the [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]].<ref name="EGWT" />

Processors enabled droids to perform a variety of specialized functions. Advanced processors of the [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]] allowed them to react quicker than their [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] cousins, making them more effective combatants.<ref name="SWE Commando droid">{{SWE|technology|commandodroid|commando droid}}</ref> The [[Dealer droid/Legends|Automated sabacc dealer droid]] had sophisticated processors which enabled them to quickly spot cheaters.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>

Processors could be located in different parts of a droid's structure. In the [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-Series battle droid]], a specialized movement processor was located at the back of the head.<ref name="NEGTD" /> The [[Central processor/Legends|central processor]] of the [[Hyena-class bomber/Legends|hyena-class bomber]] droid was located in its starboard [[Hull/Legends|hull]] unit.<ref name="SWE Hyena bombers">{{SWE|technology|hyenabombers|hyena bombers}}</ref>. The processor of the [[HMP droid gunship/Legends|HMP droid gunship]] was located in a cockpit-like structure underneath the hull.<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

State of the art digital processors were utilized in [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] limb replacements, such as [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[L-hand 980]] prosthetic.<ref name="CCG-Bionic">{{CCG|set=Cloud City Limited|cardname=Bionic Hand}}</ref>
